summary: Tag changes meant for on-premises AD are no longer lost when a large run stops part way.

fixes.title: AD tag changes always reach the hybrid worker
fixes.text: When a large tagging run stopped part way, some AD changes could wait forever and never be written. They now always reach the Hybrid worker, and no change is queued twice.

fixes.title: Runs report failure instead of false success
fixes.text: If AD changes cannot be handed to the Hybrid worker, the tagging run, undo or Tamper restore now ends as failed with the reason, instead of reporting success.

fixes.title: A failed undo says why at once
fixes.text: An undo that cannot record its outcome now ends as failed straight away, and the Backups / Undo page shows the reason.
